title: Masterman Ready; Or, The Wreck of the "Pacific"
summary: "Masterman Ready; Or, The Wreck of the 'Pacific'" by Frederick Marryat is a children's novel published in 1841. When a violent storm destroys their ship, the Seagrave family finds themselves stranded on a desert island with only a seasoned sailor named Masterman Ready to guide them. Together they must learn to survive against harsh elements and unexpected dangers.
